verdicts.reason: A is broken: three schedule rows are shrunk to illegible micro-text and scattered around the logo in the header, 'Winter Programme' is pushed off to the left, only 3 of 6 sessions are listed and at inconsistent sizes (the 20 JAN row is tiny and indented), and the legal text is enlarged to compete with the CTA.
